command:
printf '%s\n' '[identity]'
id
printf '%s\n' '[os]'
sed -n '1,8p' /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' '[application-data]'
if [ -e /var/lib/infraset-app/data/records.db ]; then
  stat -c 'path=%n type=%F size=%s mode=%a uid=%u gid=%g mtime=%y' /var/lib/infraset-app/data/records.db
  sha256sum /var/lib/infraset-app/data/records.db
else
  printf '%s\n' 'MISSING /var/lib/infraset-app/data/records.db'
fi
printf '%s\n' '[packages]'
rpm -q rsyslog firewalld policycoreutils-python-utils 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '[services]'
for s in rsyslog firewalld; do
  printf '%s ' "$s enabled="; systemctl is-enabled "$s" 2>&1
  printf '%s ' "$s active="; systemctl is-active "$s" 2>&1
  systemctl show "$s" -p LoadState -p UnitFileState -p ActiveState -p SubState --no-pager 2>&1
done
printf '%s\n' '[listener-5514]'
ss -ltnp 'sport = :5514' 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '[rsyslog-config-files]'
find /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%m %u:%g %p\n' 2>&1 | sort
printf '%s\n' '[rsyslog-relevant-config]'
grep -RniE '5514|local0|infraset|imtcp|input\(' /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d 2>&1 || :
printf '%s\n' '[firewall]'
firewall-cmd --state 2>&1 || :
firewall-cmd --get-active-zones 2>&1 || :
for z in $(firewall-cmd --get-active-zones 2>/dev/null | awk 'NF == 1 {print $1}'); do firewall-cmd --zone="$z" --list-all 2>&1; done
printf '%s\n' '[selinux]'
getenforce 2>&1 || :
if command -v semanage >/dev/null 2>&1; then semanage port -l 2>&1 | grep -E '(^|_)syslog|5514' || :; else printf '%s\n' 'semanage unavailable'; fi
ls -ldZ /var/log /var/log/infraset-app.log 2>&1 || :
:
